reason: The two-sided norm estimate is supported, but the final inference 'hence gamma is an extended K_norm e-inclusion once the homomorphism estimate is included' misuses def-extended-delta-inclusion. An extended delta-inclusion requires every amplification to be a delta-homomorphism, and the registered *-algebra delta-homomorphism condition requires exact involution preservation. The available validated homomorphism node 1.2 proves only ||gamma_n(X^dagger)-gamma_n(X)^dagger|| <= K_hom e||X||, which does not imply exact equality for e>0; enlarging K_norm cannot repair this. Thus the validated children (and the allowed external norm lemma, which asserts only norm bounds) do not imply the stated extended-inclusion conclusion.
